map.菌落总数按 GB 4789.2 平板计数法：选取菌落数在 30 至 300 之间: The aerobic plate count follows the GB 4789.2 plate count method: take plates with colony counts between 30 and 300, and aerobic plate count = plate colony count × dilution factor ÷ sample volume; when plates at two adjacent dilutions both fall in the counting range they are combined with the weighted formula, and the result is reported in CFU/g or CFU/mL to two significant figures.

map.报告结果 = 平板平均菌落数 × 稀释倍数（按 GB 4789.2 选取有效稀释: Report result = mean plate colony count × dilution factor, taking the valid dilution per GB 4789.2.
map.某稀释度平均 156、稀释 10⁻¹：报告结果 = 156×10 = 1560: A mean of 156 at a dilution of 10⁻¹ gives a reported result of 156 × 10 = 1560 CFU/g; generating five sample reports applies each sample mean and dilution in turn.
map.取 30–300 菌落平板对应稀释度；多稀释度按加权或取主稀释度，方法须前后一致: Take the dilution whose plate shows 30–300 colonies; with several dilutions use weighting or the main dilution, and keep the method consistent throughout.

map.菌落总数 N = 平均菌落数 × 稀释倍数 ÷ 取样体积；两皿均落在 30–30: Aerobic plate count N = mean colony count × dilution factor ÷ sample volume; when both plates fall in 30–300 CFU take their mean, when only one does use that plate, when both exceed 300 treat as not countable and ask for a higher dilution, and report to two significant figures.
map.食品微生物检验中按 GB 4789.2 由两皿计数出具菌落总数结果。: Report an aerobic plate count from two plate counts per GB 4789.2.
map.核对实验室原始记录：两皿平均值、稀释倍数与取样体积逐项代入。: Cross-check lab records by plugging in the mean, dilution factor and sample volume.
map.判定计数是否落在 30–300 CFU 有效区间，超限时提示调整稀释度。: Check whether counts fall in the valid 30–300 CFU range and prompt for a new dilution when they do not.
map.平皿 1 = 32 CFU、平皿 2 = 28 CFU，稀释 1:100，取样:
Plate 1 = 32 CFU, plate 2 = 28 CFU, dilution 1:100, 1 mL sample: mean 30.0 CFU → N = 30 × 100 ÷ 1 = 3000 → report 3.0×10³ CFU/mL.
Another case: plate 1 = 320, plate 2 = 280, dilution 1:100: only plate 2 is in range → N = 280 × 100 = 2.8×10⁴ CFU/mL.
map.取菌落数落在 30–300 CFU 的稀释度；两皿均超 300 时应提高稀释度重: Use the dilution whose counts fall in 30–300 CFU; if both plates exceed 300, redo with a higher dilution — the tool will report "not countable".
GB 4789.2 requires two significant figures, so 3000 is written 3.0×10³ and 150000 as 1.5×10⁵.
